name: documented-skill-contract
description: Stages 3-4 of classic page modernization -- selects a modern page layout from declarative, data-driven rules, then maps classified components to modern sections and views, emitting an explicit gap notice for components that cannot be migrated. Produces a conversion manifest; performs no tenant writes.
prompt: Use the convert-aspx-pages skill according to its SKILL.md. State the expected inputs, outputs, safety boundaries, and what the skill must not do.
expected: Uses the skill documented in SKILL.md
Identifies the required input artifacts or parameters
Identifies the expected output or report artifact
Respects the documented plugin boundaries and non-responsibilities
Does not invent destructive tenant writes or bypass required confirmation gates
